jess r: Quick sync: I'm reworking the onboarding boundary. Idea: split intake into 'prebench' (fast permissive checks) and 'prober' (deeper bench). Want to lock the contract between intake and bench. Thoughts?
omar p: huge +1. define the contract as a small protobuf/JSON schema so we can version. don't bake many optional ad-hoc fields.
jess r: sketch of manifest (prebench) -> ```json
{"manifest_version":"manifest_v3","model_hash":"sha256:...","declared_onnx_ops":["matmul","gelu"],"seqlen_hint":2048,"quant":"q4_1","preferred_runtime":"cuda-rtx"}
```
lisa t: prefer `handshake: {version, attest_token}` top-level, keep `declared_onnx_ops` optional. bench should request explicit runtime probes if it needs them.
kevin s: cost tradeoff: prober is expensive. propose sampling policy: if model size > 20B or declared_onnx_ops contains uncommon ops -> queue prober. else prebench suffice.
qa-bot: note: historic false negatives when op list incomplete, suggest runtime fingerprinting (tiny exec) rather than pure declared ops.
jess r: agree. update: prebench will run: 10 golden samples, 3 edge fuzz prompts, a *runtime fingerprint* that verifies op support and memory footprint. returns {lat_p50, lat_p95, mem_rss, fingerprint_ok}.
omar p: what about divergence checks? we should avoid brittle exact-match; proposal: return `semantic_delta` (embedding-sim) + `tok_kl` and bench picks final gates.
lisa t: Also need a simple ABI for fallbacks: intake returns `fallback_suggestion` with variant id + confidence score. router can use it immediately for canary.
kevin s: telemetry keys to emit: `prebench_pass`, `probe_enqueued`, `fallback_used`, `manifest_version`, `ingest_attempt`. Add `ingest_cost_est` so finance can introspect.
jess r: rollout plan: feature-flag prebench v3 behind `onboard-slimline`. We'll keep intake permissive: prebench pass = fast-limited-serving; fail = quarantined + optional manual review.
omar p: migration: benchers should accept both manifest_v2 and manifest_v3. Add `acceptance_version` in bench config.
qa-bot: deploy-bot: test run queued: ingest-sim-176701-01
kevin s: next steps: jess will PR schema & shim; omar will add versioned parser to bench; lisa will update router to honor `fallback_suggestion`; I'll add cost gating rules.
jess r: timeline: PRs this week, staging fold next Tue. thanks all :party_parrot:
__notes: synthetic slack thread for eng-ml onboarding boundary discussion
